messages.subject: RODBC Default Settings
parts:
Hi Can anybody please help me out with Default settings of RODBC Package.

I have to get data from an XLSB file from Excel 2010 and
But RODBC reads the first 4 lines and convert the data into numeric by turning all the original data into NAs. The column is a character vector and I want to fetch it as it is..

Can you please help me. I have tried as.is but it doesn't work at all.

================================
================================

library(RODBC)
excelcon<-odbcConnectExcel2007("C:\\Users\\201101881\\Downloads\\Arrow_Group discount_01_June_to_30_June'17.xlsb",readOnly = TRUE)
sqlFetch(excelcon,'Product Discount Sharing',as.is=FALSE)
sqlFetch(excelcon,'Product Discount Sharing',as.is=TRUE)

================================
================================

 
F1         F2    F3        F4     F5
<dbl> <fctr> <fctr> <fctr> <fctr>........................................

1 NA Item SKU Jabong Code Business Unit Category Brand Season Purchase Type NA
2 6091552520332539904 NA NA APPARELS MEN APPAREL ARROW AUTUMN WINTER 16 OUTRIGHT 2999
3 6365499745323280384 NA NA APPARELS MEN APPAREL ARROW AUTUMN WINTER 16 OUTRIGHT 2999
4 6603717079789930496 NA NA APPARELS MEN APPAREL ARROW AUTUMN WINTER 16 OUTRIGHT 2999
5 7481688168410630144 NA NA APPARELS MEN APPAREL ARROW AUTUMN WINTER 16 OUTRIGHT 2999
6 8248177212844709888 NA NA APPARELS MEN APPAREL ARROW AUTUMN WINTER 16 OUTRIGHT 2999
7 NA NA NA APPARELS MEN APPAREL

The first column should be character vector and not Numeric

Any help would do. Thanks again

But please do reply

Yours
